QuestInfo.name: The Puppeteer's Cave
QuestInfo.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant. #p1032101# says she followed the suspicious boy that appeared in #m101000000#. What did she find? Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: The boy that #p1032101# saw is definitely the Puppeteer! According to her, he lives in the forest north of #m101000000#... #bGo to #m101030500##k #bto find his hideout and report to Rowen#k.
QuestInfo.2: You spotted the Puppeteer's Headquarters, but you need a password to enter.

0.0: I saw the kid in the North Forest. I knew something fishy was going on from his shady robes and how he was hanging around monsters and NOT beating them up. Then I saw... IT.
0.1: He went to a hideout in #b#m101030500##k. It was a #bcave surrounded with huge puppets#k!\r\nI mean, if that's not the Puppeteer, I don't know WHAT to tell you!

no.0: What? You don't find the kid strange? I think you may be as strange as that boy.

0.2: Whoa, are you going to go there yourself?\r\nWell, it's your funer-I mean, choice. Go to the North Forest and keep going towards #b#m101030500##k and... you'll see what I'm talking about.\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move immediately to #m101030500#.)#k
